_readme: Findings accepted on purpose, per report: "<entry exactly as the report prints it>": "<why it is right, at least 20 characters>". A listed entry never counts as new. The check names an entry that is listed but no longer found, so remove it then. See contracts/script/refactor-reports.mjs and RefactorRulesDesign section 9.
